Tack Shot.name: Tack Shot
Tack Shot.description: The user flicks a glob or strip of tape at a target across a room and glues whatever they aim at: a hand to what it holds or to the target's side, a foot to the ground, a weapon into its holster. That part cannot move until the target tears free with a hard effort or cuts it loose, and the shot causes no injury. Strain: light.
